_doc: Region 1 progression spine (package C13). The end-of-region power targets the 100-day balance run is measured against (tools_qa/region1/balance_run.gd, report docs/regions/BALANCE_R1.md, test tests/test_balance_r1.gd), and the Rift gate: what a player must have before the main quest opens the Rift's Edge (step a5_rifts_edge). Read by scripts/region1/progression_spine.gd. Gear tier is the mean item tier, rounded to nearest with .5 going down, (data/items, tier 0..6) of the six core slots worn (main hand, body, head, legs, feet, off hand); an empty slot counts 0. Career rank is the 1-based position on the ladder the player follows (soldier ranks, Life.career_rank on ladders.json, guild rank F=1). Soul tier is soul.gd's tier index (0 Ember, 3 Tempered, 4 Forged).

rift_gate.hint: The Rift's Edge is no place to walk into half-ready. Warden Idra wants you Tempered, in iron, and past level 12 before she opens the road.
